      "name": "kernel",

      "evidence": "Updates the C API header (`src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h`) and wrapper implementation to expose `BLOCK_INCONCLUSIVE` and preserve correct error propagation at the library boundary.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Clarifies kernel error reporting by mapping a previously unset block validation state to an explicit result enum. While this improves correctness at the C API boundary, it addresses an edge case in block evaluation rather than blocking core kernel functionality."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch transaction policy, acceptance, or mempool data structures.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Matched only via keyword hints; does not alter mempool logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in `src/net_processing.cpp` (+3/-0) merely follow mechanically from introducing `BLOCK_INCONCLUSIVE`.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Updates peer processing only to account for the new validation result enum without modifying P2P protocol behavior or network architecture."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test adjustments in `txdownload_tests.cpp` and fuzz harnesses only follow from updating `ValidationState` invariants.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not modify test framework machinery or test runners."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edit to `src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp` mechanically handles the new enum value.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Follows from the validation and kernel enum update rather than altering tool features or functionality."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled 'Validation' and modifies `ValidationState` invariants in `src/consensus/validation.h` and `src/validation.cpp`.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Enforces that invalid validation states always specify a concrete failure result and non-empty reject reason, retiring a subtle hazard. As noted in the description, `TestBlockValidity` had introduced states with unset results, creating ambiguity for downstream callers."
    }
